hints.tr: Bir `while name is not None:` döngüsü kur; her turda `name = records[name]["from"]`.
hints.en: Build a `while name is not None:` loop; on every turn `name = records[name]["from"]`.

hints.tr: Döngünün başında `if name not in records:` ise `chain.append(name + " (missing)")` ve `break`.
hints.en: At the start of the loop, if `name not in records:`, do `chain.append(name + " (missing)")` and `break`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def trace(records, start):
    chain = []
    name = start
    while name is not None:
        if name not in records:
            chain.append(name + " (missing)")
            break
        chain.append(name)
        name = records[name]["from"]
    return chain


records = {
    "model-3": {"from": "data-v3"},
    "data-v3": {"from": "data-v2"},
    "data-v2": {"from": "data-v1"},
    "data-v1": {"from": None},
    "model-4": {"from": "data-v5"},
}
for name in trace(records, "model-3"):
    print(name)
print("---")
for name in trace(records, "model-4"):
    print(name)
```

def trace(records, start):
    chain = []
    name = start
    while name is not None:
        if name not in records:
            chain.append(name + " (missing)")
            break
        chain.append(name)
        name = records[name]["from"]
    return chain


records = {
    "model-3": {"from": "data-v3"},
    "data-v3": {"from": "data-v2"},
    "data-v2": {"from": "data-v1"},
    "data-v1": {"from": None},
    "model-4": {"from": "data-v5"},
}
for name in trace(records, "model-3"):
    print(name)
print("---")
for name in trace(records, "model-4"):
